results.statement: The atm-bd monitoring code for lite must be two separate layers in atm-bd-core: collectors (atm, git, beads, provider) that only gather facts, and a decision layer of pure functions from those facts to actions and report rows; the lite policy differs from the orchestration policy only in its rules (no sanity stage).
results.quote: there are a set of collectors.  atm collectors, git collectors, bd collectors.  they collect info then there is business logic layer w/ simple decision making logic based on the collectors.  this decision making logic would be slightly different for atm-bd-lite (there are no sanity agents).  everything else is pretty much the same. | the problem is spagetti code which mixes concerns. | it is the same regardless of what you are monitoring.
results.context: phase-bo replan 2026-11-01 (fenix): console profile design; existing console logic is not refactored, the layer is newly written (ANC-036) and orchestration cuts over later
